note: Tracked files (git) whose base name is .env or starts with .env., less six template names, fail; so does a tracked file an ignore rule also matches whose base name starts with .env, ends with .env or starts with env., less the templates. The ignore rules (the five root ignore files and every nested .gitignore) are probed with .env and .env.local at the root and one folder down.

Each line of every tracked text file (less template names) is tested for a key shape or a keyword with a secret-looking literal; a line with a placeholder word is skipped. The root allowlists suppress a hit, .secrets.baseline and .gitleaksignore by path and line number.

The ignore rules are probed with eleven sample paths (.env, .env.local, id_rsa, server.pem, server.key, server.p12, server.pfx, app.keystore, server.crt, server.cer, .aws/credentials); nested .gitignore files come from the scan and from git ls-files. A tracked file an ignore rule also matches whose name is one of the nine non-dotenv shapes fails.
